Version symbols are stamped via -ldflags -X (see binaries_from_source.ldflags): Version lives in the EXTERNAL module github.com/crowdsecurity/go-cs-lib/version; Codename + the defaultConfigDir/defaultDataDir path defaults live in github.com/crowdsecurity/crowdsec/pkg/cwversion + pkg/csconfig. source._no_vendor_build_note: CrowdSec ships NO web UI / dashboard / embedded frontend (the LAPI is API-only; zero go:embed of generated assets) - a plain per-package `go build` produces complete binaries. NO Node/npm asset step (the prometheus/grafana embed pattern does NOT apply); source.vendor_build is intentionally OMITTED (null).
source._cgo_decision_note: CGO_ENABLED=0 - DELIBERATE pure-Go selection, LIVE-VERIFIED static. CrowdSec's go.mod lists BOTH github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3 (v1.14.44, needs CGO=1 + gcc - the upstream DEFAULT `BUILD_SQLITE=mattn`) AND modernc.org/sqlite (v1.50.0, pure-Go). The DEFAULT upstream build is ALSO CGO for regex: BUILD_RE2_WASM=0 links the C++ libre2 library (tag re2_cgo) and `make BUILD_STATIC=1` requires a hand-built libre2.a. To get a clean CGO-free static binary we set BOTH pure-Go switches: BUILD_SQLITE=modernc (adds tag `sqlite_modernc`) + BUILD_RE2_WASM=1 (the WASM wazero regex engine, which is the build-tag DEFAULT achieved by simply NOT setting re2_cgo). `crowdsec -version` confirmed `libre2: WebAssembly` and the binary is `not a dynamic executable`. Upstream NOTE: the modernc sqlite backend is slower than mattn and 'not meant for production' per their Makefile $(info) - a PERFORMANCE caveat, not a correctness/security one; for a CE LAPI single-container with a local sqlite decision store it is the correct trade (fully static, no C deps, cleanest SBOM). A future high-throughput SKU could switch to cgo_enabled:1 + mattn + a vendored static libre2 if Scout/perf demands it.
source._offline_vendor_note: Single root `go mod vendor` is sufficient (single module). `go mod vendor` is build-tag-conservative - it vendors packages imported under ANY build tag, so BOTH modernc.org/sqlite (+ modernc.org/libc) and the wazero WASM-re2 deps land in vendor/ even though only the sqlite_modernc/no-re2_cgo configuration compiles. The offline build stage then runs `go build -mod=vendor -tags 'netgo,osusergo,expr_debug,nomsgpack,sqlite_modernc'` with CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOPROXY=off.

binaries_from_source.name: crowdsec
binaries_from_source._note: PRIMARY binary - the agent+LAPI server (run as LAPI-only via the `-no-cs` entrypoint flag). main_pkg ./cmd/crowdsec (cmd/crowdsec/crowdsec.go has main). Build tags = upstream's GO_TAGS for the pure-Go path: netgo,osusergo,expr_debug,nomsgpack (always) + sqlite_modernc (BUILD_SQLITE=modernc) and NO re2_cgo (BUILD_RE2_WASM=1, the WASM default). ldflags mirror the upstream Makefile LD_OPTS_VARS (-X paths verified in build/mk + Makefile); Version is stamped into the EXTERNAL go-cs-lib/version module, Tag=short sha 6322745, Codename=alphaga, and the config/data dir DEFAULTS baked so a flagless `crowdsec` finds /etc/crowdsec + /var/lib/crowdsec/data. LIVE: 77MB static stripped ELF; `crowdsec -version` => v1.7.8-6322745, libre2: WebAssembly. verify_subcmd `-version` (single dash, Go flag).

binaries_from_source.name: cscli
binaries_from_source._note: The CrowdSec admin CLI (the handbook/operator binary - the sqlite3-CLI parity slot). main_pkg ./cmd/crowdsec-cli (cmd/crowdsec-cli/main.go). Operators exec it inside the container to register bouncers (`cscli bouncers add <name>`), register pushing agents (`cscli machines add <name> --auto`), inspect/insert decisions (`cscli decisions ...`), and (if THEY have network) `cscli hub update` + install collections. Same pure-Go tags/ldflags as crowdsec. LIVE: 76MB static stripped ELF; `cscli version` => v1.7.8-6322745. verify_subcmd `version` (subcommand, no dash).
